name: Elf o Kau Orc "Omee nya Ora no Ko o Taanto Unde Morau Da yo!"
original_name: エルフを飼うオーク「おめぇにゃオラの仔をたぁんと産んでもらうだよ」
source:
This is the providence of nature!

Orcs have few females, so they use elves to multiply their brethren.

In this story, captive elf Aslin is "gifted" to orc warrior Mokkos for 2 years.
He may have her exclusively for that time, and his duty is vital: to make children.
After those 2 years Aslin will be offered to all the orcs for further breeding.

Be a man (orc!) and make Aslin your obedient slave! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE159100.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这就是大自然的安排！

兽人的雌性很少，所以他们利用精灵来繁衍他们的同胞。

在这个故事中，被俘虏的精灵阿斯林被“赠与”兽人战士莫科斯两年。
那时他可能只拥有她，而他的职责至关重要：生孩子。
两年后，阿斯林将被提供给所有兽人进行进一步繁殖。

做一个男人（兽人！），让阿斯林成为你听话的奴隶！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE159100.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
